scope: Local headless Chrome laboratory diagnostic, not a physical-device or launch acceptance test.

method.ready: Time from a Play link click until .overlay-tap .unlock-btn is enabled, measured with performance.now() in the same SPA realm.
method.home: Fresh browser context per repeat; navigate to Home, wait for Start first run, click directly to Play.
method.shift: Fresh context per repeat; navigate to /shift and dwell 3000 ms after Play Voltage Drop is visible. The comparison stubs navigator.connection.saveData=true to suppress only the optional story prefetch; no other application code reads saveData.

limits: Three repeats are a diagnostic, not the fixed 26-observation performance budget.
The shift prefetch helps only visitors who open /shift and remain long enough; the Home primary CTA goes directly to Play.
A warm, service-worker-served first attempt was excluded after showing zero network transfer; every recorded observation used a fresh context with service workers blocked and cache disabled.
